summary.en-US: Apply personalized-spelling to form inputs you allow. Only those forms are seen or checked.

description.en-US:
Puts personalized-spelling on form inputs you have allowed — and on no others.

You choose certain form inputs on certain sites. personalized-spelling is not watching the web. Once you opt in, that form gets the regular spellcheck: the same checks, the same one-click fixes, the same personal dictionary. Nothing else about the site changes. Submit is not blocked.

It docks beside the form (the default). A + on that form's side opens the suggestions; click again to make it small on the side. Several allowed forms on one page each have their own +.

Allow a form from the toolbar icon on that page.

version.approval_notes: Form text is read only after the user allows a specific field on a site. No page content is sent off the machine. Bundled files: typo-js (typo.min.js, upstream minified), Hunspell en_US aff/dic, Norvig wordfreq list, mcphee.js/css copied in by build.sh. data_collection_permissions is none.
